decisions.reason: A multi-model handle family close to the core range, still listed in 2019, that ties up tooling and catalogue investment the firm would be reluctant to write off. Several sibling handle lines were already quietly pruned, so some drop risk remains.

A single handle design costs little to drop and carries no public commitment, so it is more exposed to range pruning. It survived the 2019 cull of sibling designs, though, which suggests it is still being sold.

The L700 LightAccess system is a publicly promoted flagship with heavy development investment and sits central to the firm's announced digital building direction. Any weak results would likely be blamed on temporary market adoption issues rather than lead to withdrawal.
